# PropertyIQ

> AI-powered real estate market intelligence platform that ranks 900+ US metros, 3,000+ counties, and 29,000+ ZIP codes.

## Overview

PropertyIQ generates a single PropertyIQ Score (1-99) that predicts a market's 3-year performance relative to its state. The score is built from four monthly market signals — Zillow home-value momentum (12-month and 3-month) plus Realtor.com median days on market and the share of listings with price cuts. It is a transparent, equal-weight formula with no fitted parameters or black-box model. Validated across 20+ years of out-of-sample data (2001-2023 scoring vintages), the score-to-return relationship is positive in every backtested year at every geography level.

## Scoring System

PropertyIQ generates a single **PropertyIQ Score** (1-99) for every geography:

- **50 = state average** — higher predicts outperformance relative to the market's state over the next 3 years
- Built from 4 demand-signal inputs: Zillow ZHVI 12-month momentum (positive), Zillow ZHVI 3-month momentum (positive), Realtor.com median days on market (negative), and the share of listings with price cuts (negative)
- Formula: `z(zhvi_yoy) + z(zhvi_mom_3m) − z(median_days_on_market) − z(price_reduced_share)`, equal weights, no fitted parameters
- Each input is converted to a cross-sectional z-score across all markets at a geography level each month (national basis), summed, percentile-ranked, re-centered so the zero-crossing maps to 50, and clamped 1-99
- Coverage: 900+ metros, 3,000+ counties, 29,000+ ZIPs; monthly history backfilled to 2001

### Validation Results

Validated out-of-sample across 2001-2023 scoring vintages (20+ years, two full housing cycles):
- The score-to-return relationship is positive in every validated calendar year at metro, county, and ZIP levels
- 2016-onward out-of-sample information coefficient (3-year forward excess return vs state): +0.27 metro, +0.20 county, +0.20 ZIP
- Monotonic score-band separation: higher score bands realize higher 3-year excess returns vs state with no adjacent inversions
- Permutation tests place the signal far above a shuffled-target null at every geography level

## Data Sources

| Source | Metrics | Update Frequency |
|--------|---------|-----------------|
| Realtor.com | Active listings, median prices, days on market | Monthly |
| Zillow | ZHVI home values, ZORI rent indices, inventory | Monthly |
| Redfin | Sale prices, price drops, new listings | Weekly |
| U.S. Census Bureau | Population, income, housing units (ACS) | Annual |
| FRED | Mortgage rates, GDP, macroeconomic indicators | Monthly |
| BLS | Unemployment rates, employment statistics | Monthly |
| BEA | Regional GDP, personal income | Quarterly |

## Coverage

- 900+ metropolitan statistical areas (MSAs)
- 3,000+ counties
- 29,000+ ZIP codes

- 64+ data points per market
- Monthly data updates

## Pricing

- **Free**: 5 property lookups/month, basic scores, metro-level data
- **Pro** ($29/month): Unlimited lookups, full score breakdown, AI-generated reports, ZIP-level data
- **Team** ($99/month): Everything in Pro plus team collaboration, API access, and custom reports

## Competitors

PropertyIQ differentiates from competitors through validated predictive scores:
- vs Mashvisor: 4.6x more market coverage (900+ vs ~200 metros), monthly updates vs quarterly
- vs NeighborhoodScout: AI-powered predictive scores vs descriptive analytics
- vs Reventure: Granular ZIP-level data vs metro-level only
